claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Abstract only: a tool interprets photographs of hand-drawn design sketches and proposes optimized force-flow structures; an artificial neural network is trained to generate structures matching the sketched load cases, intended to reduce designer effort in conceptualizing lightweight structures. The abstract names no classical optimization method and gives no quantitative comparison of any kind (speed, cost or design quality).
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not derivable: the abstract contains no timing, cost or quality figure and no named classical comparator. Full text (which would hold the primary outcome per protocol §5.1) is inaccessible.
claim.alternatives: None identifiable from the abstract alone.
